question: Gandhi Jayanti is an event held in India to commemorate Mahatma Gandhi's birthday in the month of _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**October**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On **October 2, 1869**, in **Porbandar, Gujarat**, Mahatma Gandhiji was born.
 
• In **India**, a national holiday called **Gandhi Jayanti** is observed to commemorate **Mahatma Gandhi**'s birth.
 
• One of India's three national holidays, it is observed on the second of **October** each year.
 
• Since he was a **nonviolent freedom fighter**, the **UN General Assembly** announced on **June 15, 2007,** that it had passed a resolution designating October 2 as the*** *****International Day of Non-Violence.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• On October 2, people around the world honour** Gandhi. **
 
• It is a **federal holiday** that is celebrated across the nation's states and territories.
 
• All around India, especially at** Gandhi's tomb, Raj Ghat,** in** New Delhi,** where he was cremated, prayer services and tributes are held to **commemorate Gandhi Jayanti.**
 
• Prayer gatherings and **commemoration celebrations** held by colleges, **local government agencies**, and **socio-political organizations** in many cities are popular activities.
